desc: Ideation: select binary search on target T with independent per-vitamin calorie DP.

Implement complete Python solution: read stdin, group items by vitamin and cost, prune each cost group, build three dp arrays (max vitamin for each calorie capacity), prefix-max, feasible(T) via smallest capacities summing <= X, binary search, output.
Verify on sample inputs and edge cases such as missing vitamin type, X=1, all items same cost, and large A values.
